purpose: Immutable release-candidate snapshot fixing RC4-QA-001: rc4's own manifest.v1.json omitted a deprecated/implementation.graph.v4.yaml entry even though rc4's own criterion PKGV2-T18 required the manifest to bind that file's SHA-256 as proof the move to deprecated/ preserved the user's originally approved graph byte-for-byte. The live file's digest was, and remains, correct (0d5b5af8b0c60847e3b52ac93c4c10328f48a1404130a6b785485bcbbae3d571) -- the defect was an incomplete manifest, not a wrong digest or a mutated file. This snapshot adds that manifest entry and supplies the file itself as --ground material. Every other reviewed file is byte-identical to rc4's own copies, which are in turn rc4's fix for the N00 schema blocker found after rc3 (session 019ffcc7-a48f-7870-a933-5d80bb61dac3, QA_PASSED, chain_valid true) was approved: plans/27_langgraph_curriculum_factory_remediation/schemas/spec_approval.schema.v1.json const-locks approved_spec to the parent v1 package's own spec, a path this package's approved specification v4 can never equal.

corrects_prior_generation_finding.finding_title: RC4 manifest omits the deprecated approved graph
corrects_prior_generation_finding.note: rc4 is preserved exactly as it was and is not reopened, edited, or overridden. Its one finding was a manifest-completeness omission, not a logic defect in any reviewed file -- confirmed by every other file's SHA-256 being unchanged between rc4's manifest and this one.

source_note: Every file below (other than deprecated/implementation.graph.v4.yaml, which is immutable historical content unchanged since its original approval) is byte-identical to the live package-v2 file at the same relative path at snapshot time, reconfirmed immediately before this snapshot was taken: `python3 -m pytest -q plans/27_langgraph_curriculum_factory_remediation/execution_package_v2/tests/test_execution_package_v2.py` -> 133 passed; `python3 plans/27_langgraph_curriculum_factory_remediation/execution_package_v2/tools/validate_plan_v2.py` -> valid: true.
reviewed_artifact_note: The single file submitted to qa-gate-codex-run as --artifact. It embeds the full verbatim text of every file under review (unchanged from rc4's own bundle, since no reviewed file's logic changed in this generation). deprecated/implementation.graph.v4.yaml is genuinely static historical content, not logic under review, and is supplied separately as --ground material rather than embedded in the bundle.
deterministic_validation_note: controller/scan_node.py, tools/validate_plan_v2.py, tools/validate_result_v2.py, and tests/test_execution_package_v2.py bind to their own absolute repo-relative path (Path(__file__).resolve() arithmetic), unchanged since rc1. A byte-identical copy placed under release_candidate/rc5/ therefore cannot be independently re-executed in place, exactly as every prior generation confirmed. Behavioral identity is established by SHA-256 equality against the live plans/27_.../execution_package_v2/ files (below), reconfirmed passing immediately before this snapshot was taken (see source_note).
